chunks: There is only the life of this world: We die and we live: there is no rising from the dead for us.
ai.seo_question: What do disbelievers believe about life and death according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the core dogmatic dispute between the materialists of Mecca and the Prophetic message, specifically emphasizing the inevitability of bodily resurrection (al-Ba'th al-Jismani). It serves as a direct rebuttal to those who reduce human existence to mere biological cycles, thereby denying the accountability that necessitates divine justice in the Hereafter.
